fact: A carrion crawler erupts from the earth, resembling a colossal maggot with paralyzing tentacles.
source_quote: It was a carrion crawler, a grotesque creature resembling a colossal maggot lined with paralyzing tentacles.
subject: carrion crawler

fact: The carrion crawler is drawn to the party by the noise of the rescue efforts.
source_quote: drawn by the noise of the rescue.
subject: carrion crawler ambush

fact: Zalthir casts a line of fire on the carrion crawler as his first action.
source_quote: Zalthir went first and exhaled a searing line of fire.
subject: Zalthir

fact: The carrion crawler takes 10 damage from Zalthir's fire line after failing its Dexterity save.
source_quote: The crawler blew its Dexterity save and took 10 damage
subject: Zalthir's first fire blast

fact: Zalthir pulls back behind the other party members after his first attack.
source_quote: and Zalthir pulled back behind the others.
subject: Zalthir repositions

fact: The carrion crawler strikes Gyrgum with a tentacle, dealing 4 damage and dropping him.
source_quote: The crawler struck Gyrgum with a tentacle for 4 damage and dropped him
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum is currently downed by the carrion crawler.
source_quote: dropped him
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The carrion crawler turns its jaws on Thorin and hits him for 7 damage.
source_quote: turned its snapping jaws on Thorin and hit him for 7.
subject: Crawler attacks Thorin

fact: Thorin attacks the carrion crawler with a short sword, dealing 4 piercing damage.
source_quote: Thorin answered with a precise thrust of his short sword for 4 piercing damage.
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin's short sword has the Vex property, which grants him advantage on his next attack.
source_quote: The weapon's Vex property gave him advantage on his next attack
subject: Thorin

fact: Shuushar, Turvy, Topsy, Sarith, and Buppido fire hand crossbow bolts at the carrion crawler.
source_quote: Shuushar, Turvy, Topsy, Sarith, and Buppido, raised their hand crossbows and loosed a volley of bolts into the creature's hide.
subject: Companions volley

fact: The companions' volley lands four critical hits on the carrion crawler for 20 damage.
source_quote: landed four hits, and dealt 20 damage.
subject: Companions volley damage

fact: Zalthir casts fire again, but the crawler twists aside and takes only 2 damage.
source_quote: Zalthir unleashed another blast of fire, but the crawler twisted aside and took only 2 damage.
subject: Zalthir's second fire blast

fact: Thorin uses his Second Wind feature to regain ten hit points.
source_quote: Thorin caught his breath with Second Wind for ten more hit points.
subject: Thorin

fact: The carrion crawler's jaws miss Thorin, missing by one point against his AC.
source_quote: The crawler's jaws missed Thorin by one point against his AC
subject: Crawler misses Thorin

fact: The carrion crawler's tentacle misses Sarith spectacularly.
source_quote: a tentacle aimed at Sarith "misses spectacularly."
subject: Crawler misses Sarith

fact: Eldeth is currently nearing death.
source_quote: Eldeth was nearing death
subject: Eldeth

fact: Gyrgum is rolling death saves.
source_quote: Gyrgum rolled death saves
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum has passed two death saving throws.
source_quote: Gyrgum rolled death saves and passes twice.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Daz is stable and does not need to make death saving throws.
source_quote: Daz is stable, so he does not need death saves.
subject: Daz

fact: Daz continues to roll ordinary successes for potential hit point recovery.
source_quote: Daz kept rolling successes while staying stable.
subject: Daz

fact: Thorin orders Topsy and Turvy to dig out Eldeth and Jimjar.
source_quote: Thorin had Topsy and Turvy dig out Eldeth
subject: Rescue order given

fact: Jimjar is trapped and requires rescue by Topsy and Turvy.
source_quote: Thorin had Topsy and Turvy dig out Eldeth ... and Jimjar.
subject: Jimjar

fact: The remaining three companions deal 15 damage to the carrion crawler, killing it.
source_quote: The three companions still shooting put 15 more damage into the crawler and killed it.
subject: Crawler killed

fact: The carrion crawler is dead.
source_quote: Once it was dead, everyone came round
subject: carrion crawler

fact: Gyrgum is conscious again but is at one hit point.
source_quote: Gyrgum at one hit point.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The party finds no loot on the carrion crawler's corpse.
source_quote: There was no loot, so the party harvested the carcass instead.
subject: No loot found

fact: The party harvests the carrion crawler's corpse for food.
source_quote: the party harvested the carcass instead.
subject: Carcass harvested

fact: Gyrgum rolls a 9 on 2d6, yielding nine rations.
source_quote: Gyrgum's 2d6 roll produced nine rations
subject: Food roll

fact: The party obtains nine rations of carrion crawler meat.
source_quote: nine rations, about two days' food with the mushrooms.
subject: nine rations

fact: The harvested carrion crawler meat tastes like chicken.
source_quote: the meat tasted remarkably like chicken.
subject: Meat taste
